command.AMEND_REGISTRATION.label: Amend registration
command.AMEND_REGISTRATION.meaning: Replace the initial facts. The handler''s case reference remains unchanged.
command.CLEAR_PAYMENT.label: Correct an erroneous payment record
command.CLEAR_PAYMENT.meaning: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.
command.CLOSE.label: Close the case
command.CLOSE.meaning: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.
command.CORRECT_CASE.label: Correct case facts
command.CORRECT_CASE.meaning: Correct recorded details on a case with a decision, payment or closed status. All changes are recorded together. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.
command.DECIDE.label: Record payment decision
command.DECIDE.meaning: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.
command.ERASE.label: Erase case payload
command.ERASE.meaning: Permanently remove business payload from the live database. WAL, backups and copies elsewhere are not erased.
command.OPEN.label: Open a case
command.OPEN.meaning: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.
command.RECORD_PAYMENT.label: Record actual payment
command.RECORD_PAYMENT.meaning: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.
command.REINSTATE.label: Reinstate case record
command.REINSTATE.meaning: Restore ordinary case work on a voided record.
command.REOPEN.label: Reopen the case
command.REOPEN.meaning: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.
command.VOID.label: Void case record
command.VOID.meaning: Block business commands while retaining the case and its history.
command.WITHDRAW_DECISION.label: Withdraw payment decision
command.WITHDRAW_DECISION.meaning: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.
